Context: Cenditions applicable for ad hoc Bonus :

5. Casual Labour.Eligible if they have worked for at least 240 days in offices following 6-day week and 206 days' in offices following 5-day week in each year for three or more years as on 31st March of the relevant financial year. Quantum of Bonus determined on a notional monthly wage of~ 1,200 irrespective of actual monthly wages. Condition of being in service on 31st March not applicable.  
General:-  
1. Rounding off.The amount of bonus calculated in all cases to be rounded to the nearest rupee.
